spots.text: THE STARS ARE NOT FOR READING. PLEASE DO NOT LEAN ON THE SKY.

secrets.name: The Deck Under the Glass
secrets.text: Under the open pane a ladder, and under the ladder a little deck hung in the night. The readers' chair legs stand on the glass above you. Someone has left a telescope pointing down.

meta.label: The Star Floor
meta.blurb: The floor is glass, and under the glass is the night sky, a very long way down. The readers do not look at it. You try not to either.
